text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While most of the spectators predicted a 
victory for Biwa Hayahide—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dubbing Matikanetannhauser the 
'Representative of the Ordinary,' many 
fans passionately rooted for her, inspired 
by her relatability and encouraging 
spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, in the underground tunnel, Biwa 
Hayahide and Tokai Teio shook hands, and 
then—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unlike during the Classic year when she 
watched from the sidelines, Matikane 
Tannhauser now walks down the center 
stage, chest puffed out proudly, as if 
saying, "I'm here too!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Joined by Nice Nature, the four praised 
each other's efforts. And finally—the 
curtain rises on the year-end grand 
showdown, the Arima Kinen!
